evidence.quote: All My Gods, Bethnal Green - Dive Bar in Rail
All My Gods is open Wed-Sun, and can be found at 253 Paradise Row, E2 9LE
A new bar has opened in Bethnal Green with a vending machine that dishes out BuzzBallz.

notes: Found in the CAMRA WhatPub E2 listings (live music stated). Time Out article dated Monday 4 August 2025 says it opened the week before, so it is over a year old: the opening is not news, it is only the source for the address. The venue's own site (allmygodsbar.com) refused: robots.txt unreachable, so not fetched. Events not yet checked: no listing or ticket page found.
